sandboxes.screen.empty: No sandboxes yet. A sandbox is a creative copy of this world.
sandboxes.confirm.sync.title: Sync this sandbox?
sandboxes.confirm.sync.body: %s is replaced with a fresh copy of this world. Anything built in it is lost.
sandboxes.confirm.delete.title: Delete this sandbox?
sandboxes.confirm.delete.body: %s is deleted for good. This can't be undone.
sandboxes.button.overlay_key.tooltip: This sandbox's overlay key. In your world it shows this sandbox's overlay; inside the sandbox it compares with your world. Right-click to clear.
sandboxes.compact.title: Sandboxes
sandboxes.settings.quick.desc: A small button in the pause menu's top-right corner. In your world it jumps to the sandbox you used last; inside a sandbox it takes you back.
sandboxes.settings.quick_inventory.desc: The same button in the top-right corner of the screen while your inventory is open, in survival and creative.
